attempts.prompt:
Use-case: stylized-concept. Production raster ingredient for the Madness personal desktop atelier, not a UI mockup.
Generate exactly ONE square PNG asset: an independent painted plate-edge FRAME, a thin hollow square frame with genuinely transparent alpha in its very broad empty center and around its chamfered outer corners. Intended canvas 1024 by 1024 pixels. Front orthographic view, perfectly flat and axis-aligned; no perspective, no mockup presentation, no cast shadow.
Construction for CSS 9-slice: the frame occupies only the OUTERMOST approximately 8 percent on each side of the square canvas. The central square, from 8 percent to 92 percent in both axes, is completely empty and truly alpha transparent, with no paint, haze, texture, backdrop, paper, checkerboard, or color in that hole. Straight parallel horizontal and vertical frame edges, even narrow width, clear separable corner sections. Small simple angular chamfers at the four corners. Keep all material confined to the perimeter, with a quiet uninterrupted straight middle on each edge so the edge strips can stretch to rectangular panels of different aspect ratios.
Material and visual world: a hand-painted matte petrol-blue steel plate frame from a warmly inked, cel-shaded graphic-novel workshop. Dark muted petrol body around #234550 and #2D5360, confident dark anthracite ink contours around #151B1D at the OUTER and INNER plate edges. Broad quiet painted planes with only subtle dry-brush grain; restrained, sparse natural scuffs and a few fine exposed dark-metal and muted copper/terracotta edge nicks around #9D6949, not rusty or heavily distressed. Slight variation is painted flat color, never a smooth gradient. Ink and wear remain subordinate to the frame silhouette. The material must read at a final CSS edge width of about 12 to 18 pixels and remain calm beside long conversation text. Compatible with both warm dark anthracite and warm ivory application themes.
No content inside the frame. NO letters, words, numbers, labels, icons, symbols, UI controls, characters, portraits, scenery, large props, bolts, rivets, screws, cables, machinery attachments, glow, glass, glossy reflections, photographic metal, volumetric lighting, gradient or drop shadow. Do not redraw or reproduce any existing approved illustration or application screenshot. Deliver only this reusable thin painted frame, with native real alpha transparency.
